title: Word Search
tagline: Pick a theme, your word count and the clock. Find every word.
description: Six music-and-life themes with 75 words each. Before you play, choose a theme, 15 (Easy), 30 (Medium) or 60 (Hard) words, and Timed or Untimed. Big, well-spaced letters: the grid fills the screen, and goes tall on phones held upright. Drag across a word in any direction or tap its first and last letters; found words get a colored highlight and are crossed off the list below the grid. Hints, a pick-your-own-words option, and progress saved on this device.
